# Sheeba The Nutritionist

> Sheeba The Nutritionist is a functional nutrition and naturopathy clinic in Singapore, run by nutritionist Sheeba Majmudar. She uses blood chemistry analysis, functional health assessments and holistic therapies to find the root causes of health problems, then builds personalised diet, supplement and lifestyle plans.

## About Sheeba Majmudar

- Master of Science in Human Nutrition (USA)
- Bachelor of Arts (Psychology)
- Diploma in Clinical Herbology (USA)
- Two decades of clinical practice with over 20,000 clients worldwide
- Author of the book *Edible to Incredible* (available on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/Edible-Incredible-Sheeba-Majmudar/dp/1482831818)
- Awards include Nutritionist of the Year (Prestige Awards 2020/2021), Best Naturopathic Nutritionist (APAC Business Awards 2021) and Outstanding Best International Nutritionist (South East Asia Business Awards, APAC Insider 2021)
- Consultations are available in person in Singapore or virtually

## Health assessments

- [Metabolic Mapping](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/health-assessments/metabolic-mapping): functional analysis of 42+ metabolic markers from a blood test, used to design a personalised health plan
- [Food Compatibility Test](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/health-assessments/compatibility-testing): non-invasive hair-sample test covering over 600 foods and household products that may trigger inflammation
- [DUTCH Test](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/health-assessments/dutch-test): dried urine hormone test, including hormone metabolites
- [Hair Tissue Mineral Analysis](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/health-assessments/hair-tissue-mineral-analysis): hair test for mineral levels and heavy metal toxicity

## Therapies

- [E4L (Energy4Life) System](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/therapies/e4l-nutri-energetic-system): bioenergetic scan followed by liquid Infoceuticals
- [Aromatherapy](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/therapies/therapeutic-aroma-therapy): therapeutic-grade essential oils used alongside a client's protocol
- [Weight (Fat loss) programs](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/therapies/dropzone): Dropzone, a practitioner-guided fat loss programme created by Sheeba Majmudar (https://www.dropzone.fit)
- [Practitioner Supplements](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/therapies/practitioner-supplements): practitioner-grade supplements that support a client's protocol
- Also offered: [Gemmotherapy](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/therapies/gemmotherapy), [Reconnective Healing](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/therapies/reconnective-healing), [Biodynamic Craniosacral Therapy](https://www.sheebathenutritionist.com/therapies/biodynamic-craniosacral-therapy)
